This is an application seeking anticipatory bail filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.

The petitioners are accused Nos.2 and 3 in Crime No.607/2025 of Kottakkal Police Station,
Malappuram District.

The offences alleged against the petitioners and other accused are punishable under Sections 420, 456 and 468 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.

The prosecution case, as narrated in Annexure A2 order, reads thus:
"Between 16th June, 2010 and 2013, the accused Nos.1 to 3, who were the Secretary,
president and Director of the Thennala Service Co- operative Bank at Kozhichena.

in Kottakkal, made the defacto complainant believe that she would obtain loan from the above said bank and based on a fabricated document, the accused obtained loan in favour of the defacto complainant and created a liability of Rs.2,39,430/- to her."[SIC]
4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor.
The learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that the petitioners have no role in the offences alleged.
It is submitted that the petitioners retired from service of the Bank.
It is further submitted that as 15 years have elapsed since the commencement of the transaction, the attempt of the defacto complainant is to harass them.

6. The learned Public Prosecutor submitted that there are credible materials to show that the petitioners and the other accused fabricated documents and fraudulently obtained loans in the names of the defacto complainant.
It is submitted that the petitioners managed to see that no notice for recovery of the loan was issued to the defacto complainant.
It is further submitted that custodial interrogation of the petitioners is required.
7. The learned counsel for the petitioners submitted that since 2013 they have no role in the management of the Bank.

sentences.text: 8. I have gone through the Case Diary.
9. Having regard to the circumstances made out, I feel that the petitioners are not entitled to the extraordinary remedy contained in Section 482 of the BNSS.
Therefore, the bail application stands dismissed.
However, the petitioners are directed to appear before the Investigating Officer on 17.12.2025 at 10 am for interrogation.

If the Investigating Officer effects the arrest of the petitioners upon their surrender and produces them before the learned Magistrate, and if the petitioners file an application seeking regular bail, the learned Magistrate shall consider the same and take a decision thereon, preferably on the date of filing itself.
